messages:
incident-bot: [P1] gcp-southeast1 autoscaler failing to attach GPUs — Compute API returning quota errors. Queue length spiking. Pager sent to @infra-oncall. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/gpu-attach-quotas
infra-oncall: Ack. I'm on it. Can someone paste the top error lines from the attach failures?
sam.harper: Logs from the attach controller: `ERROR: instances.attachAccelerator: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 123456789 (rateLimitExceeded)`. Happening across multiple zones in region.
marta.chen: Queue metrics — pending requests: 1,250 (+85% in 20m). Median latency for model-serving requests jumped from 120ms -> 3.4s. Percent of requests hitting fallback CPU models: ~18%.
jess.prod: Customer-facing impact: 3 enterprise clusters reporting increased 5xx latency and timeouts. Support ticket numbers: #7892, #7893. CS notified for high-touch customers.
dallas.sre: Quick mitigation idea: lower per-request GPU pinning to 1 and force autoscaler to prefer us-east1 as overflow. Can we change routing while quota is contested?
infra-oncall: Good call. I can add a routing rule but need approval to relax affinity. Also we should enable the CPU fallback for low-priority traffic.
sam.harper: Trying a manual routing change now: `kubectl patch svc inference-router -n prod -p '{"spec":{"sessionAffinity":"None"}}'` — applying.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: route-change deployment v2.1 started by sam.harper.
marta.chen: Also increasing autoscaler cooldown to 5m to avoid thrashing while we move traffic.
jess.prod: I'll draft a short banner for affected customers: "Intermittent increased latency and request queuing in gcp-southeast1. We're shifting traffic and working on quota escalations." Want to push in 15m if impact persists.
dallas.sre: To confirm the root cause: per-project GPU quota is exhausted (not per-zone). Quota request to GCP submitted earlier today but pending. ETA from support: 24-48h. We need region-level mitigations now.
infra-oncall: Rolling out temporary overflow route to us-east1 for non-low-latency classes. Command: `redwoodctl route update --from-region gcp-southeast1 --to-region gcp-us-east1 --profile noncritical`
incident-bot: Action log: overflow routing applied by infra-oncall. Some traffic shifted (~40% of noncritical). Queue drop in SE1: from 1250 -> 780 in 10m.
sam.harper: Observed a small spike of errors during the route change — `502 upstream read timeout` for a minute, then steady. Tracking.
marta.chen: Next step: contact Cloud quota team, escalate with account rep. Jess, can you loop sales/CS for the top 3 impacted customers?
jess.prod: On it. Pinged sales and CS with status + draft banner.
dallas.sre: Temporary capacity hack: reduce per-instance GPU requests from 4 -> 2 for new pods to spread capacity. Will roll as canary to avoid mass evictions.
infra-oncall: Rolling the per-instance GPU reduction as a staggered rollout. Will monitor preemption/eviction risk.
support-bot: Support: tickets #7892,#7893 updated with status and external banner draft.
incident-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff in 28m. infra-oncall please update the runbook before handoff.
infra-oncall: Will do. Summary to add: quota exhausted at project level; overflow routing to gcp-us-east1 applied; per-pod GPU cap lowered to 2; CPU fallback enabled for low-priority traffic; quota request escalated to GCP rep.
marta.chen: Customer impact summary for handoff: ~4% requests dropped or errored for high-priority customers, 18% hitting CPU fallback (degraded quality). Ongoing: queue ~600 and trending down.
infra-oncall: Handoff to @marta.chen in 25m. Marta — you'll own the cloud escalation and customer comms. I'll stay reachable.
marta.chen: Taking it. I'll maintain the routing and follow up with GCP rep. If queue stabilizes under 300 for 15m, we'll relax some changes.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigation in progress. Assigned: marta.chen. Next update expected in 15m.
